21 hours ago 📅 Part-time toddler drop-off program in Port St. Lucie
Looking for a few free hours while your little one learns and plays? The Toddler Drop-Off Program runs Tuesdays and Thursdays, 9 a.m.–12 p.m., Sept. 1, 2026 through Apr. 29, 2027 at the MIDFLORIDA Event Center Tot Room, 9221 SE Event Center Place, Port St. Lucie 34952 .
Details:
Ages 3–4 , must be potty trained Class size: 10 toddlers with one staff member Fee: $125 per month What to bring each day:
Change of clothes Lunch Two snacks Water bottle Registration opens Aug. 4. To sign up, you must:
Turn in a registration packet at sign-up Complete emergency and photo permission forms The first 10 children who register and pay get a guaranteed spot for the whole season (through April 29, 2027 ). After that, kids go on a waitlist and are enrolled only if a spot opens.
